title: Grateful Dead Live at The Omni on 1991-04-05
lineage: Transfer: Dat > Tascam DA-40 > Tascam DA-3000 > Flac 16/48
taper: Master Digital FOB Recording by Dave Brotman & Jeff Metchick
source: Recording: Schoeps CMC3 MK4’s (ORTF) > Panasonic SV-255 (16/48) Location: FOB mics hand held, section 5, row FF, seat 7

ai_review.summary: High‑quality audience (FO) recording of one of the spring tour’s best shows.
ai_review.review: Reviewers praise this front‑of‑house capture as superior to the well‑known Fitzy/Keo/Nak/Senn mixes, noting its clear and pleasant sound. The concert itself is described as a standout performance from the spring ’91 tour, making it a worthwhile listen despite the lack of specific song commentary.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one detailed 4‑star review; both performance and recording are described positively, leading to an overall rating around four stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear front‑of‑house mix that outshines the popular Fitzy/Keo/Nak/Senn audience mixes; pleasant balance and detail.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Mentioned as one of the spring tour’s best shows, implying strong overall flow and energy.
